svg.title: Initialize a new project from intent
svg.desc: Choose this route only when meaningful source does not yet exist. A decomposition persona is not an extra agent dispatch. Existing source selects the separate brownfield route. Actual endpoint: Populated project state, the three approved project-level Markdown documents, an initialization sentinel and no abandoned decomposition drafts. Code implementation and PR delivery are later work. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scaffold → interview → approve three documents → initialize

svg.title: Choose the new-project route
svg.desc: command: /ca:init: scaffold once → command: /ca:decompose: selected strategy → skill: decompose: establish or resume drafts. A writable project-state scaffold and a valid new-project interview or explicit resume choice. An initialized project is not reinitialized.

path.title: no meaningful source: The stub must pass through its greenfield populator.
interview owner: The selected skill prepares persistence before questioning.

g.title: /ca:init: scaffold once. The scaffolder writes activation and empty state but no initialization sentinel. It refuses to overwrite existing state; an uninitialized stub enters its selected populator directly.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace

g.title: /ca:decompose: selected strategy. Automatic detection or --greenfield chooses the decomposition workflow. Source-shape mismatches remain stops rather than forced population.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: decompose: establish or resume drafts. Confirm pre-flight, explain the interview and inspect any existing draft session. Resume, restart and abort are user choices; do not silently delete prior drafts.

svg.title: Review three guiding documents
svg.desc: skill: decompose: complete each layer → skill: decompose: synthesize from disk → skill: decompose: iterate until approval. All three project-level documents are on disk and explicitly approved. Their tasks are not a typed feature execution plan.

path.title: complete durable input: Synthesis rereads the layer and draft-decision files rather than trusting conversation memory.
user review: No population until all three outputs are approved.

g.title: decompose: complete each layer. Explore problem, users, capabilities, technical shape, integrations and risks. Persist completed layers and draft choices. Unresolved facts receive named questions instead of guesses.

g.title: decompose: synthesize from disk. Reread the drafts and write 01-architecture-breakdown.md, 02-phased-build-plan.md and 03-task-backlog.md under .codearbiter/plans/ before review.

g.title: decompose: iterate until approval. Open each document, request corrections and approve all three explicitly. The existence of files or a conversation summary cannot stand in for this decision.

svg.title: Populate and lock initialization
svg.desc: skill: decompose: populate project context → skill: decompose: initialization lock and cleanup. Inspect the populated tree, required files and sentinel. The interview did not generate a release-target row or meaningful source-code provenance.

path.title: inspect then lock: The skill closes only after the required state and cleanup are confirmed.

g.title: decompose: populate project context. Reread the approved documents and layers, populate context and the task board, and promote the draft choices as specified. Write interview-derived provenance stubs and a coarse code-map stub.

g.title: decompose: initialization lock and cleanup. Write the initialization sentinel, verify required state and remove the completed draft directory. Report normal operation, leaving implementation for the appropriate next lane.
